column2: t２１１／２／アペムンタ村壊滅報告

column4: \t\tかなみか誰かが情報を聞く
column5: Kanami or someone else hears some information. It is reported

column4: \t\tさきほどいかなかったアペムンタ村は皆殺しになったと報告
column5: that Apemunta Village, which they hadn't gone to earlier, was

column4: \t\t本来、そんな村に無体な事は無意味なのに不思議な事だと
column5: completely massacred. Normally, it would be pointless to do such

column4: \t\t憎しみがあったように一人も逃がさず・・
column5: cruelty to a village like that; it's a strange matter. It was as if

column4: \t\t他の村にはそういう事は無いです
column5: there was hatred, not letting a single person escape... Such things
did not happen in other villages. I wonder if something happened...
